effects.does: Opens Clara's assistance panel for the event.
effects.affects: It can use the event's line-item data to generate or summarize content.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify the Clara panel opens.

effects.does: Opens the attachment control so the buyer can add files.
effects.affects: Adds event-level attachment data for later use or submission.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify a file-selection control appears.

effects.does: Opens the terms-and-conditions control so the buyer can add or edit clauses.
effects.affects: Updates the event's terms_and_conditions data.
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify the terms editor opens.

effects.does: Opens the line-item manager showing two items.
effects.affects: Allows the event's line_items collection to be reviewed or changed.
effects.check: Click Items 2 and verify two line items are shown.

effects.does: Saves the current event as a draft.
effects.affects: Creates or updates the draft event and stores its line items and stage identifiers.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here or returns to the draft event view
effects.check: Click Save as draft and verify the event remains draft and reopening it preserves the entered data.

effects.does: Validates and publishes the event.
effects.affects: Moves the event from creation into its published or active flow and submits its stages and project data.
effects.leadsTo: Published event view or an error state
effects.check: Click Publish with valid data and verify a success result and the published event state.

effects.does: Selects RFQ as the event mode.
effects.affects: Sets the current stage's mode to RFQ and can reset incompatible existing event data when the mode changes.
effects.check: Select RFQ and verify RFQ configuration and fields are displayed.

effects.does: Opens template selection for the event.
effects.affects: Sets the stage template and may reset existing template-dependent data when an existing template is changed.
effects.check: Click Buy Template and verify available templates are displayed.

effects.does: Opens controls for adding or removing table columns.
effects.affects: Changes which line-item fields are visible in the event form.
effects.check: Click Add Columns and verify column options appear.

effects.does: Opens or focuses the event details section.
effects.affects: Changes the visible editing section but not event data by itself.
effects.check: Click Details and verify the event-details controls are shown.

effects.does: Opens or focuses price-component configuration.
effects.affects: Changes the visible pricing configuration area and any price-component data entered there.
effects.check: Click Price Components and verify price-component controls are shown.

effects.does: Opens or focuses participant management.
effects.affects: Changes the event's invited vendor or participant list when vendors are added or removed.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify participant-management controls are shown.

effects.does: Opens or focuses the savings section.
effects.affects: Changes the visible savings configuration and any savings data entered there.
effects.check: Scroll to Savings, click it, and verify savings controls are shown.

effects.does: Opens or focuses the terms-and-conditions section.
effects.affects: Changes the event's terms_and_conditions data when clauses or attachments are edited.
effects.leadsTo: Terms and Conditions section or drawer
effects.check: Scroll to Terms & Conditions, click it, and verify the terms editor is shown.

effects.does: Opens the schedule control showing the current start time and 30-minute duration.
effects.affects: Changes the stage start, end, and duration schedule when edited.
effects.check: Click the displayed schedule and verify the schedule editor opens with the shown values.

effects.does: Switches to the Technical Stage tab.
effects.affects: Changes the active stage being configured without itself changing event data.
effects.check: Click Technical Stage and verify its tab becomes active and its fields load.

effects.does: Keeps the RFQ stage selected.
effects.affects: Changes only the active stage view and not the event data by itself.
effects.check: Verify RFQ is marked selected and its configuration is visible.

effects.does: Navigates to the Events area.
effects.affects: Nothing in the current event's data or flow.
effects.check: Click Events and verify the Events screen opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Accepts the project title entered by the buyer.
effects.affects: Sets the project's title used in draft and publish payloads and validation.
effects.check: Enter a title and verify it remains in the field and is used after saving.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Searches for and adds vendors to the event.
effects.affects: Updates the event's audience_company_uuids and participant list.
effects.leadsTo: Stays here with the selected vendor added
effects.check: Search for a vendor, select it, and verify it appears among the selected participants.

effects.does: Displays or accepts the product for each line item.
effects.affects: Sets the line item's product_uuid, which is required for saving or publishing.
effects.check: Verify each line item has a Product value and that an empty value is rejected.

effects.does: Displays or accepts the product variant for each line item.
effects.affects: Sets the line item's product_quality_uuid, which is required for saving or publishing.
effects.check: Verify each line item has a Product Variant value and that an empty value is rejected.

effects.does: Accepts the requested quantity for each line item.
effects.affects: Sets the line item's requested quantity used in the event and vendor response flow.
effects.check: Enter a valid quantity and verify it is retained and an empty required value is rejected.

effects.does: Accepts the delivery location for each line item.
effects.affects: Sets the line item's delivery-location data used for fulfillment information.
effects.check: Enter or select a delivery location and verify it is retained.

effects.does: Accepts the price for each line item.
effects.affects: Sets the item's price used in bid comparison and amount calculations.
effects.check: Enter a price and verify the value is retained and reflected in the calculated amount.

effects.does: Accepts the quantity available for each line item.
effects.affects: Sets the available-quantity value used in the line-item data.
effects.check: Enter a quantity available and verify it is retained for that line item.

effects.does: Displays or accepts the GST value for each line item.
effects.affects: Changes the tax input used in the item's amount calculation when editable.
effects.check: Verify the GST field is present and any entered tax value is retained.

effects.does: Displays the calculated total amount for each line item.
effects.affects: Reflects the calculated amount from the item's pricing and applicable tax inputs.
effects.check: Change the price or GST and verify the total amount recalculates.

Each draft stage → `GET /v1/trade/:id/schema?response_type=template&additional_fields=order_details&l1_prices=true` (plus `&rfq_to_auction=true` when converting), then `GET /companies/audience_for_product?trade_request_uuid=<id>` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1143-1165, src/models/

Publish never stores the returned stage uuids (only Save as draft does), so a retry after a failed project PATCH (e.g. 712) POSTs every stage again — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1826-1839 vs 1516-1536

Switching between RFI and RFQ/Auction warns "Switching event mode will reset existing data." and on save clears template, sheet, savings, currencies and ALL project participants — auctionConfiguration.jsx:390-407, 898-903, src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:505-536

Title "Are you sure you want to award this vendor?", field "Quantity Offered *" pre-filled with the vendor's `participant_quantity` and unit suffix; info "TR is pending for this line item." when unscored — src/components/dataGrid/formatters/comparisonSelectionFormatter.jsx:29-74

`draftStageIds` without `projectId` → single draft stage is loaded and its title becomes the project title; with `projectId` → every listed stage is loaded and the last one is selected — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2244-2257, 1157-1161, 1437-1445

Saving the strategy drawer in project creation resets the stage title to the auto title computed with no other stages (`allModes: []`), overwriting a renamed title and its number — src/views/eventCreation/components/auctionConfiguration/auctionConfiguration.jsx:497-506

First save → `POST /event_groups` `{status:"draft", title, line_items:[{product_uuid, quantity:{unitSymbol,value}, product_quality_uuid, serial_number, pr_line_item_uuid, pr_id}]}`; later saves → `PATCH /event_groups/:id` — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:2259-2269, src/redux/project/a

Drawer disabled when fromPR, `isEditingAllowed=false` or `isAddNewStage`; variant shows "Variant of product cannot be modified", quantity/unit " 'Quantity Requested' and 'Unit of Measurement' cannot be modified" (quantity still editable when fromPR) — src/views/projectCreation/components/projectLine

Shown only when not RFQ→Auction, `allow_draft_project_creation` on, not (service-RFP grouping AND `groupServiceActivitiesInRfp`), auctions not routed to the auction team, and the current stage is not recurring — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:292-296, 3343-3345
Disabled with tooltip "Please select template for <stage title>" for any non-RFP stage without a template, or "Please add line items" — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1457-1481

choosing "Custom duration" first sets end to undefined; closing the popover then Save passes (NaN comparisons) and publish fails "Please add end time for the event" — stageSchedulerCard.jsx:302-314. Backend has no end>start / end>now check (trade-stages.md part 8): candidate API test with past `bid_

Changing an existing template asks "Do you really want to change the template?" (project) / "Changing template will reset data. Are you sure?" (quick-create), OK "Yes" — templateSelection.jsx:349-360, src/translations/en.json eventCreation.handleTemplateDataReset
In project creation `product`, `creator_quantity`, `variant` are locked; PR events also lock READ_ONLY_WIDGETS_IN_PR_TO_AUCTION and `blockEditFromPr` widgets — templateSelection.jsx:248-272

AI RFP → `POST /ask_ai_chats/rfp_questions`, then `GET /external_requests/:uuid`; the AI button needs project line items — src/views/eventCreation/components/aiRfpGenerator/api.js:3-11, src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:1854-1876

Currency prefix = selected base currency label, else template currency (symbol or code per stored preference), else dashboard default; price/amount columns get the selected base symbol — src/views/eventCreation/eventCreation.jsx:378-393, 1159-1195

Master QCS tab hidden for users whose team types include planner, and until at least one stage is non-draft; lot events get one Master QCS child per lot (`master_qcs?lotNo=`), plus a top-level one when `all_lots_withdrawn` — src/redux/project/selectors.js:39-40, 1408-1445

Draft project reopen → `GET /event_groups/:id/get_line_items?filters={}&prevent_pagination=true`; a response without a `data` array navigates back with toast "Error while loading draft project" — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1413-1423, src/redux/project/actions.js:291-306
`terms_and_conditions` is ALWAYS present in the body, even when the caller passed no T&C (clauses undefined, attachments value []) — src/redux/project/actions.js:71-82

selecting a template re-fetches config with that template's filter and the effects above rewrite closingOn / T&C of EVERY stage, not just the one being edited (unverified live) — src/views/eventCreation/templateSelection.jsx:148, src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1929-1959
Clara summary panel renders when `isClaraEnabled` is FALSE and the project has a claraSummary (FE-15.2 states the inverse) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:3405-3409

Auto stage title = "<Label> <n+1>" where n = existing stages of that mode; for the first one the code produces "Auction " / "RFQ " / "Technical Stage " WITH a trailing space — src/views/projectCreation/helpers.js:1010-1041
Publish with empty project title → "Please fill project title!" before any other check; a whitespace-only title passes (truthiness check) — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1599-1602
Project title input is disabled when adding a new stage to an existing project — src/views/projectCreation/projectCreation.jsx:1433-1435, 3283-3292
Save with nothing changed (same count, product, variant, quantity per index) → drawer closes, no API call — src/views/projectCreation/components/manageLineItemsModal.jsx:83-121
No items left → "Please add atleast one item to proceed!" — src/views/projectCreation/components/manageLineItemsModal.jsx:86-88, 127-130

cases.title: Publish with empty project title displays validation error
cases.expected: The system stops execution and displays the error message 'Please fill project title!'.
cases.setup: Leave the project title field completely blank.

cases.title: Add Attachments modal opens successfully
cases.expected: The file attachment drawer or modal opens allowing document uploads.
cases.setup: Be on the quick-create event screen.

cases.title: Save event progress as draft
cases.expected: The project is saved successfully as a draft and a success confirmation is displayed.
cases.setup: Fill in the mandatory project title and at least one line item.

cases.title: Save as draft sends the first draft event-group request
steps: Enter a project title in "Enter the title of the project".
Complete the required cells under all required columns.
Open browser developer tools and monitor network requests.
cases.expected: The first save sends a POST request to create the event group with status "draft", the entered title, and the line-item values. The screen remains in the draft flow without publishing the event.
cases.setup: Open a new quick-create RFQ with both line items available.
gaps: The exact line-item values sent in the request because the case does not specify concrete values for the required cells.
That the observed POST is definitively the first event-group request rather than merely a request sent during the run.

cases.title: Publish refuses an event with no participants
steps: Enter a project title in "Enter the title of the project".
Complete the required cells under all required columns.
Leave "Search vendors you want to add" empty.
cases.expected: Publishing stops and the app shows "Please add participants to proceed!". The event is not published.
cases.setup: Open a new RFQ with no vendor selected.

cases.title: Ask Clara opens AI assistance when line items exist
steps: Open browser developer tools and monitor network requests.
cases.expected: The AI RFP assistant opens. The app sends a POST request to "/ask_ai_chats/rfp_questions" and then requests the generated data from "/external_requests/:uuid".
cases.setup: Open the screen with the two displayed line items.
gaps: Whether the AI RFP assistant visibly opens, because the catalog has no assertion specific to the assistant's resulting UI.
